headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service facility in Fredericksburg, Virginia, as the Gladys P. Todd Post Office.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building at 1285 Emancipation Highway in Fredericksburg, Virginia, a new official name. The building will be called the Gladys P. Todd Post Office. The law does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
